blocks.text: Chromosomal mutations genes ki jagah ya chromosomes ki banawat ya tadaad mein bari tabdeeliyan hain. Yeh aam taur par khud-ba-khud hoti hain.

Chromosomal rearrangements jismani tabdeeliyan hain jaise deletions, duplications, inversions aur translocations, aam taur par DNA double helix ke do jagah se tootne se. Translocation mein aik chromosome ka hissa doosre ka hissa ban jata hai; inversion mein chromosome ke hisse ka rukh ulat jata hai.

blocks.alt: Pattiyon wale chromosomes ke chaar hisse, har aik Before aur After. Deletion: dabbe wala neela hissa gum. Duplication: dabbe wala neela hissa do baar. Translocation: chromosome 4 aur chromosome 20 ke dabbe wale sire jagah badal lete hain. Inversion: do toot ke darmiyan ka hissa ulat jata hai, rangeen pattiyan ulti tarteeb mein. Har chromosome ka centromere qaim rehta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.24: Chromosomal rearrangements (kitab ki Figure 19.24 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Insertional inactivation: DNA ke bohat se chhote tukre, transposons ya jumping genes, genome mein aik jagah se doosri ja sakte aur nayi jaghein ittefaqan chunte hain. Kuch genes mein ghus kar unhein nakara kar dete hain; yeh qudrat mein aam hai aur bohat si insani genetic bimariyan isi se hain. Kitab ki misaal X chromosome par clotting factor IX ke gene mein insani transposon ka ghusna hai jo gene ke beech stop codon rakh deta aur X-linked haemophilia karta hai.

Kabhi kabhi meiosis mein chromosomes theek alag nahi hote, to gamete mein aik chromosome barh ya ghat jata hai. Ise non-disjunction kehte hain; agar aisa gamete zygote banaye to fard mein shadeed kharabiyan ho sakti hain. Yeh autosomes ya sex chromosomes mein ho sakti hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat: maa ki umr
blocks.text: Non-disjunction waqt ke saath sperm ke muqable mein eggs mein kaheen zyada mumkin hai, kyunke aurat ke sab mustaqbil ke eggs us ki paidaish tak prophase I tak pohanch chuke hote hain, yaani woh us jitne hi purane hote hain, jab ke mard rozana naye sperm banate hain. Is liye maa ki umr baap se zyada ahem hai.

Chromosomes ki kul tadaad 47 (2n+1) hai. Ise pehli baar 1866 mein J. Langdon Down ne bayan kiya aur yeh taqreeban har 750 mein se aik bachche ko hota hai. Yeh autosome jore 21 ki non-disjunction se hota hai jo egg bante waqt ho sakti hai: jora alag nahi hota, 24 chromosomes ka egg banta hai, aur normal sperm se fertilization ke baad trisomy 21 wala bachcha, larka ya larki, paida hota hai. Alamaat mein zehni kami, ruki nashonuma, gardan ki pusht par zyada jild, chapti chehre ki banawat, chhota sar, chhoti gardan aur aaza, oopar ko jhuki aankhein, chhote kaan, kamzor muscles, bahar nikli zabaan aur dil ke nuqs shamil hain. Mard aam taur par baanjh aur auratein kam zarkhez hoti hain. Achhi dekh bhaal, aam masail ki screening, ilaaj, achha khandani mahol aur khaas taleem, zindagi behtar karti hai.

blocks.alt: Insani karyotype: chromosome jore 1 se 22 teen qataaron mein, centromere par seedh mein; chromosome 21 ki teen copies surkh daire mein; sex chromosomes X aur Y, ya X aur X.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.25: Down syndrome ka karyotype (kitab ki Figure 19.25 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Agar maa mein X chromosomes alag na hon to egg ko dono X (XX) ya koi nahi (O) mil sakta hai. XX egg Y sperm se fertilize ho to 47 chromosomes (44 + XXY) wala XXY banta hai; baap mein non-disjunction bhi XY sperm de sakti hai jo normal X egg ke saath XXY deta hai. Yeh Klinefelter syndrome hai jo American tabeeb Harry Klinefelter ke naam par hai jinhon ne 1942 mein ise bayan kiya. Mutasir larke baanjh mard bante hain jin mein kuch zanana khasiyatein (jism par kam baal, chhati ka barhna), chhote testes, lambi taangein, chhota dhar, koolhon jitne kandhe aur kam bhaari awaaz hoti hai. Ilaaj mein balooghat se testosterone, chhati ke tissue ka operation, aur zabaan, school aur samaji mushkilaat ke liye rawaiye ki therapy shamil hai.

blocks.alt: Insani karyotype: chromosome jore 1 se 22 teen qataaron mein aur sex chromosomes X, X aur Y surkh daire mein; kul 47 chromosomes.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.26: Klinefelter syndrome ka karyotype (kitab ki Figure 19.26 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat: triple X
blocks.text: XX egg X sperm se fertilize ho to 47 chromosomes aur XXX wali larki, yaani triple X syndrome. Aisi auraton mein seekhne ki mushkilaat, lamba qad aur door door aankhein ho sakti hain; woh zarkhez hoti aur balooghat maamool ki umr par hoti hai.

O egg aur Y sperm se OY zygote banta hai jo nahi barhta, kyunke insan X chromosome ke genes ke baghair zinda nahi reh sakta. O egg aur X sperm, ya O sperm aur X egg, se 45 chromosomes, XO (2n-1 ya 44 + XO), wali larki banti hai, yaani sex chromosomes ki monosomy: Turner syndrome, jise American mahir-e-ghudood Henry Turner ne 1938 mein pehli baar bayan kiya. Alamaat mein chhota qad, jaali dar (webbed) gardan, na pukhta jinsi aaza aur baanjhpan, aur chhoti thodi aur jabra shamil hain; Turner syndrome wali zyada tar larkiyon ki zehanat normal hoti hai, kabhi khaas seekhne ki mushkilaat ke saath. Yeh jigar aur gurde ke masail, motape, diabetes aur high blood pressure se juri hai. Yeh taqreeban har 2500 larkiyon ki paidaish mein aik baar hota hai. Bachpan mein jaldi shuru kiya growth hormone qad barhata aur estrogen ka mutabadil ilaaj sanwi jinsi khasiyatein laata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne Turner syndrome ki shareh (frequency) taqreeban 5000 larkiyon mein aik chhapi hai. Sahi adad taqreeban 2500 larkiyon mein aik hai (tibbi hawale 2000 se 2500 mein aik batate hain). Kitab alamaat mein 'low mental abilities' (kam zehni salahiyat) bhi likhti hai; asal mein zyada tar ki zehanat normal hoti hai, kabhi khaas seekhne ki mushkilaat ke saath.

blocks.alt: Baen, egg banne mein nondisjunction: XX cell se O egg aur XX egg; normal X ya Y sperm se milne par XO (larki, Turner syndrome), OY (zinda nahi rehta), XXY (larka, Klinefelter syndrome) aur XXX (larki, XXX syndrome). Daen, sperm banne mein nondisjunction: XY cell se O aur XY sperm; normal X eggs se milne par XO (Turner syndrome) aur XXY (Klinefelter syndrome).
blocks.caption: Figure 19.27: Sex chromosomes ki nondisjunction (kitab ki Figure 19.27 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Nondisjunction mein jore wale chromosomes alag nahi hote, is liye kuch gametes mein dono aur kuch mein koi nahi (O) aata. Aisa gamete normal gamete se mile to zygote mein sex chromosomes ek kam ya ek zyada hote hain: XO Turner, XXY Klinefelter, XXX triple X, aur OY zinda nahi rehta.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat: zyada ya kam autosomes
blocks.text: Aik autosome kam wala zygote nashonuma mukammal nahi kar sakta, aur zyada tar aik zyada autosome wale bhi zinda nahi rehte. Taham chromosomes 13, 15, 18, 21 aur 22 teen copies mein ho sakte aur fard kuch arsa zinda reh sakta hai. Zyada 13, 15 ya 18 shadeed nuqs aur chand maheenon mein maut ka sabab hai; zyada 21 ya 22 wale aam taur par jawani tak zinda rehte hain, haddiyon ki der se pukhtagi, chhote qad, kamzor muscles aur mutasir zehni nashonuma ke saath.

blocks.prompt: 45 saal ki aurat ke 25 saal ki aurat se zyada Down syndrome wala bachcha hone ka imkaan kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Us ke eggs paidaish se pehle se prophase I mein ruke hain, yaani 45 saal purane, aur eggs ki umr ke saath non-disjunction ka imkaan barhta hai.

items: Banawat: deletion, duplication, inversion, translocation; transposons genes nakara kar sakte.
Down 47 (+21); Klinefelter 47 (XXY); Turner 45 (XO); triple X 47 (XXX); OY zinda nahi.
